products.product_description: Mini Naan Eight (8) nann packaged in coated paper printed board and transparent wrap with a net weight of 12.6 oz (360 g) per package and old under the US Foods brand. Product is labeled with instructions to keep frozen until use. Eight (8) packages per case.
products.reason_for_recall: The products were shipped without labels declaring the nutrition and ingredients information and the presence of egg, milk, and wheat allergens.
